visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a black tank top and a blue safety helmet rides a dark scooter along a sunlit paved road lined with green trees. A small child in a purple shirt and a helmet sits in front, and a small dog is perched on the footboard. (2) Close-up shot of water pouring rapidly into a dark vessel, creating white foam and ripples. A man in a black tank top stands in a kitchen, patting his stomach with both hands. (3) A tap pours water into a clear glass, which is then shown being held in a hand. In a supermarket, rows of colorful bottled water and tea are visible on refrigerated shelves. A young child in a pink shirt drinks from a large clear plastic bottle. (4) Inside a utility room, a large white vertical water softener stands. Transition to an under-sink area showing white filtration canisters with 'Filtrete' labels. (5) A sleek white and black rectangular SANSUI water purifier is showcased on a wooden surface in a studio environment. The man points to the top digital display which reads '150ml 25C'. (6) The man is shown lying in a bedroom next to the unit, then sitting on a toilet in a bathroom while drinking from a clear pitcher. He taps the touchscreen interface multiple times. (7) Hot water is dispensed from the unit into a white instant noodle cup on a kitchen counter while a cat watches from the side. (8) Hands pull out a large cylindrical white filter from the top of the machine. An animated graphic shows six layers of filtration with moving spheres. (9) The man pours a full pitcher of water over his head in a bathroom, then demonstrates placing the pitcher back into the unit. (10) A montage shows the pitcher being placed in a refrigerator, used to pour water into a pot on a stove, and carried by hand outdoors. (11) The final shot displays the SANSUI purifier alongside two clear pitchers with promotional text overlays and pricing.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Varies between an outdoor residential street, a supermarket beverage aisle, a modern home kitchen with cabinets, a bedroom with a wooden nightstand, and a bathroom with light tiles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music starts with a driving beat. A male narrator begins an enthusiastic delivery in Mandarin with a clear Hokkien accent. (2) A sharp splash sound occurs followed by the continuous sound of running water as a glass is filled. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) The narrator's pitch rises and falls dynamically to emphasize points about water hardness. (4) A digital chime/ding sound marks a transition. (5) Short 'pop' sound effects and digital 'click' UI noises are heard as the narrator demonstrates the machine's features. (6) Sound of trickling water occurs as the man pours hot water. (7) A mechanical sliding and clicking sound occurs when the filter is removed and reinserted. (8) The BGM swells slightly during the promotional summary phase. (9) A final high-arousal vocal pitch from the narrator concludes with a call to action over the continuing upbeat music bed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Solution Introduction -> Feature Demonstration -> Practical Usage Montage -> Technical Details -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive promotional advertisement for the SANSUI RO water purifier. It uses a relatable vlog-style opening to highlight the poor water quality in Southern Taiwan (problem) and then positions the compact, installation-free purifier as the perfect household solution (benefit). The content emphasizes convenience, filtration efficacy, and cost-effectiveness to drive viewers to a crowdfunding platform.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of product name, features, price discounts, and specific call-to-action for a crowdfunding platform.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends social media vlog aesthetics with professional product videography. The use of Hokkien-accented Mandarin targets a specific regional demographic in Taiwan, enhancing local appeal and trust.
